design_gotchas.title: Mixed Legacy SFAB vs Modern RFB Silicon Lottery Under Non-H TL082IDR (Table 9-1, p.28)
design_gotchas.detail: Per Rev O (Sep 2025) Table 9-1 (p.28), non-H TL082IDR reels may contain EITHER legacy CSO:SFAB die (10–30 V, 3 MHz, 18 nV/rtHz, negative-rail phase reversal) OR modern CSO:RFB die (4.5–40 V, 42 V abs max, 5.25 MHz, 37 nV/rtHz at 1 kHz, ±10 mA ESD rail clamps, 0.00012% THD+N). Specify TL082HIDR (-40..125°C, 937.5 uA/ch) for deterministic new-die performance.

design_gotchas.title: Negative-Rail Input Headroom ((VCC-) + 4 V) & Phase Reversal Risk on Legacy Lots
design_gotchas.detail: Common-mode input includes VCC+ but stops at (VCC-) + 4 V on D-package recommended specs (±11 V guaranteed on ±15 V, p.9, p.14). TL082IDR cannot sense near ground in 5 V single-supply LM358DR sockets, and legacy SFAB lots suffer output phase inversion if inputs approach VCC-.

design_gotchas.title: Modern TL082IDR vs TL072IDR Convergence — Both Shift to 37 nV/rtHz (2x Higher Than Legacy 18 nV)
design_gotchas.detail: Historically TL072 was noise-screened while TL082 was general-purpose; in TI's unified modern RFB silicon (SLOS081O Rev O p.16, p.28), BOTH TL082IDR and TL072IDR specify 37 nV/rtHz at 1 kHz (21 nV/rtHz at 10 kHz)—over 2x noisier at 1 kHz than legacy 18 nV/rtHz JFET lots and 4.6x noisier than OPA2134UA (8 nV/rtHz). Verify noise budgets before pro-audio swaps.

design_gotchas.title: Rev O Lowered HBM ESD to ±1500 V & Added ±10 mA Input Clamp Current Ceiling
design_gotchas.detail: Revision O (Sep 2025, p.9 & p.29) lowered HBM ESD from 2000 V to ±1500 V, and modern RFB silicon adds input-to-rail ESD clamp diodes requiring external series resistors to limit fault current <= 10 mA when inputs swing > 0.5 V beyond supply rails (Footnote 3, p.9).

typical_use_cases: General-purpose split-supply (±12 V / ±15 V) industrial integrators, active filters, and high-Z buffers
Pin-compatible JFET second source for TL072IDR on non-noise-critical ±15 V analog and solar/UPS stages
High-slew-rate (20 V/us) dual instrumentation and motor-drive feedback amplifiers up to 40 V rails
Guitar effects pedals, active crossovers, and pro-audio line buffers where 65 pA input bias is required
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TL082IDR is an industrial-grade (-40°C to +85°C) dual high-voltage FET-input operational amplifier in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package rated up to 40 V operating (42 V abs max) on current production specs (Rev O, Sep 2025). Delivering 65 pA typ input bias current, 5.25 MHz GBWP, 20 V/us slew rate, and 100 dB CMRR at 1.4 mA/ch Iq, it closely mirrors TL072IDR on the standard dual SOIC-8 pinout. Engineers must account for TI's mixed SFAB/RFB die shipping under non-H TL082IDR (shifting 1 kHz noise to 37 nV/rtHz — specify TL082HIDR for deterministic RFB silicon), its (VCC-) + 4 V negative input headroom, and incompatibility with 5 V ground-sensing LM358 circuits.
